h1: Outrise 首页需求与英文文案（2026-11-02 版）

callout.p: 状态：本版是当前首页内容及三组视觉探索的依据。先比较 A、B、C 三组桌面稿与手机首屏，选定构图后再制作完整响应式 HTML。旧版内容、图片与评论保留为历史参考。

p: 对外定位：Outrise 是专注北美市场的 AI-native 营销与增长团队：帮助消费品牌与科技创业公司判断方向、选择渠道、制定规划，并推进约定的关键执行。
内容调整：让访客先理解市场与团队角色，再判断客户适配、看到真实项目经验、了解业务和合作方式。外部 CMO 只在持续合作正文解释，不作为 Hero 或套餐名称。
首版范围：英文单页；中文需求说明。使用真实邮箱，不新增表单、业务 API、数据库、CRM、子页面或正式域名上线。本轮完成需求与三个视觉方向，选定后制作完整 HTML。
目标客户：消费品牌：面向北美市场的品牌建设与电商增长。科技创业公司：不同类型产品的 GTM、价值表达、目标用户和营销渠道选择。两类同等权重，不退回 Consumer Tech 窄范围。
内部边界：是否承接按营销目标与团队能力判断。首页不承诺传统 B2B 线索系统、产品内激活与留存系统、产品改造、完整 PLG 或全面日常代运营。渠道、交付量、频率、预算、执行深度和费用在项目中约定。
h2: 2. 两项核心能力与三类直接执行
p: 服务体系：Marketing Strategy & Brand Foundations ＋ Channel Operations & Growth → Content Marketing / Influencer Marketing / Paid Media → 按需专业协作
层级要求：两项核心能力共同连接执行，视觉权重相同。三项直接执行处于下一层，不能做成五项同权服务套餐。
专业协作：按需组织渠道拓展、落地执行、技术搭建及其他专项支持，由 Outrise 判断需求、联系和筛选资源、协调交付。GEO、SEO 留在具体需求沟通与提案中，不占首页主服务区。
阅读顺序：Hero → Who We Help → Selected Experience → Capabilities → Why Outrise → How We Work → Working Together（含 FAQ）→ Closing / Footer。
导航：正式 A2 Logo / Who We Help / Selected Work / Capabilities / How We Work / Let’s talk。导航对应 #who-we-help、#selected-work、#capabilities、#how-we-work；联系入口为 mailto:hello@outrisetech.com。
手机与页尾：Footer 复用同一组导航，提供邮箱与 Back to top → #hero。手机菜单保持同一去向，支持键盘关闭并返回触发按钮焦点。
h2: 4. 逐区块说明与完整英文文案
p: 区块目标与排版：首屏清楚表达北美市场、AI-native、营销与增长团队及两类客户。标题和简述可独立成立；手机首先保留标题、简述与操作。
Section label：AI-NATIVE. NORTH AMERICA FOCUSED.
H1：Your AI-native marketing and growth team for North America.
Body：We help consumer brands and tech startups define their position, choose the right channels, and turn plans into focused marketing action.
Primary action：Let’s talk → mailto:hello@outrisetech.com
Secondary action：Explore our work → #selected-work
区块目标与排版：两类客户等权并列，每类写客户任务、参与方式和关注点；手机按同一顺序单列。
Section label：WHO WE HELP
H2：Build your brand. Bring your product to market.
Intro：Different products. A shared need to decide where to focus in North America.
CONSUMER BRANDS：Build recognition and ecommerce momentum.

Body：Entering North America or building on an existing presence? We help clarify your audience and brand story, then connect content, creators, and channels with how people discover and buy your products.
Focus：Brand positioning · Content and creator direction · Ecommerce channel priorities
TECH STARTUPS：Turn product value into a focused go-to-market plan.

Body：Launching a product or revisiting your go-to-market plan? We help explain what the product makes possible, identify the people it matters to, and choose the marketing priorities and channels for your stage.
Focus：Value proposition · GTM priorities · Channel and launch planning
h3: 4.3 selected-work — 先看实际项目经验
p: 区块目标与排版：三类匿名案例以品牌与渠道整合作为首个主案例，渠道启动与第二阶段 GTM 为两项紧凑案例。区分背景、判断、工作范围；不展示结果数字、品牌标识或可追溯客户信息。
Section label：SELECTED EXPERIENCE
H2：Strategy put to work.
Intro：Selected project experience across channel launches, GTM decisions, and brand-to-channel execution. Client identities are withheld.
CONSUMER BRAND · INTEGRATED MARKETING：Connecting brand and channels.
Context：A consumer brand needed a coherent marketing foundation for its North American launch.
Judgment：The existing brand ideas and product strengths needed to connect with local audiences and channel-specific content.

Our contribution：Our team worked on positioning, reusable content, creator activity, ads, and coordination across TikTok, Amazon, and the brand website. Published brand articles and an advertising landing page formed part of that work.
Work covered：Brand and product messaging / Content and creator coordination / Website and ecommerce connections
CONSUMER BRAND · CHANNEL LAUNCH：Launching a new channel.
Context：A consumer brand was starting a TikTok channel in North America.
Judgment：The initial work focused on which product benefits, audiences, and creator approaches to test.
Our contribution：Our team contributed to creator collaborations and AI-assisted script and creative testing, then used content and paid-media feedback to refine the next round of work.
Work covered：Audience and message priorities / Creator collaboration / Creative testing and review
TECH PRODUCT · SECOND-STAGE GTM：Finding the next growth path.
Context：A tech hardware product faced slower growth and a heavy reliance on creator-led sales.
Judgment：The next phase needed a clearer product story and a broader mix of owned content and exposure beyond TikTok.
Our contribution：Our team helped reshape the GTM plan around use cases and creative value, and coordinated the direction of content, creator activity, paid media, and wider exposure.
Work covered：Product value and use cases / Owned-content direction / Broader channel planning

h3: 4.5 why-outrise — 解释 AI-native 与市场理解
p: 区块目标与排版：四项内部工作关系连接市场理解。团队承担判断、方向和质量；不做仿真软件界面、工具墙或未经证实的效率数字。
Section label：WHY OUTRISE
H2：AI-native in how we work. Market-aware in what we do.
Intro：AI is part of our established working system. Our team owns the business judgment, direction, and quality of the work.
Working system heading：Research, planning, creation, and learning stay connected.
Research & knowledge：Organize information and build a shared foundation for decisions.
Planning & tasks：Connect decisions with tasks, responsibilities, and progress.
Content & creative：Explore ideas, support production, and iterate on materials.
Feedback & improvement：Bring project learning into the next plan and the way we work.
Market heading：Understand the product. Read the market.

Market body：We translate product logic into user value and marketing action. As AI changes how people discover information, evaluate products, and make decisions, we revisit the message, channel choices, and next tests.
Relationship：Product logic → User value → Marketing action
h3: 4.6 how-we-work — 把流程与产出连起来
p: 区块目标与排版：三阶段整合 Deck 六步，展示可能交付物和共同决策；项目可以循环调整，交付示例不是固定套餐。
Section label：HOW WE WORK
H2：From business questions to the next clear move.
Intro：Make the important choices together. Put them into a plan. Keep the work moving and learn from the response.
Stage 01：Understand & assess
Body：Learn the product, business goals, audience, and constraints. Research the market and identify the marketing questions that matter.
Possible outputs：Market and audience assessment · Strategic questions
Shared decision：Agree on the problem and the decisions to make.
Stage 02：Choose & plan
Body：Compare the options. Define positioning, channel roles, priorities, resources, and responsibilities for the next stage.
Possible outputs：Positioning and messaging · Stage roadmap · Channel and action plan
Shared decision：Confirm the direction, plan, and division of work.
Stage 03：Execute & adjust
Body：Deliver the agreed work, coordinate the people involved, review market feedback, and decide what to continue or change.
Possible outputs：Agreed marketing deliverables · Review notes · Next actions
Shared decision：Review the work and choose the next move.
Note：These are examples of possible outputs. Each engagement defines its own deliverables, depth, and review rhythm.
h3: 4.7 working-together — 说明责任与合作深度
p: 区块目标与排版：三种合作方式并列说明；持续模式正文解释 CMO。精简 FAQ 回答适配、现有团队、执行范围、专业伙伴。
Section label：WORKING TOGETHER
H2：One point of contact. One accountable team.

Body：Within the agreed scope, Outrise takes responsibility for strategy, progress, quality, and specialist coordination. Your team brings product knowledge, business context, resources, and timely decisions.
Strategy Consulting：Work through a defined market, positioning, or channel question and leave with a reasoned direction and next steps.
GTM & Brand Projects：Build a plan around a specific stage objective, then move the agreed priority work through to delivery.

Ongoing Marketing Coordination & Team Support：Keep strategic discussions, resource coordination, and reviews connected. In an ongoing engagement, we can take on an external CMO role and provide agreed execution support.
Agreement：Every engagement starts with agreed goals, deliverables, responsibilities, and a way to evaluate the work.
FAQ 1：Who is Outrise best suited to?

Answer：Consumer brands entering or growing in North America, and tech startups that need to clarify their go-to-market priorities and move key marketing work forward. We start by discussing your goals, stage, and resources.
FAQ 2：Can you work with our existing team?
Answer：Yes. We can support an internal team, lead an agreed program, or coordinate with existing agencies and specialists. We define responsibilities and decision points together.
FAQ 3：How do you decide what execution is included?

Answer：We choose the work that supports the agreed objective, then define the channels, deliverables, responsibilities, timing, and review rhythm. The mix can include content, creator collaborations, paid media, and coordination with your team.
FAQ 4：How do specialist partners take part?

Answer：When specialist support is needed, we identify the required capabilities, select suitable resources, and coordinate their work. Outrise remains your point of contact and is accountable for the agreed delivery.

h2: 6. 视觉探索与 Brand Guidelines v2.0
p: 三组方向：A｜编辑式品牌顾问：米白主底，左侧大标题，右侧主红 24° 切面与工作素材窗口，细线分区。B｜作品先行：米白标题区、宽幅素材组合、主红案例标题带。C｜大胆品牌表达：主红首屏、白色大标题、米白案例区，编号与对齐组织关系。
交付范围：每组目标为 1440px 桌面纵向构图，覆盖 Hero、客户、案例与服务体系，另配 390px 手机首屏；三组事实和核心文案一致。实际生成尺寸另行记录，构图目标不当作实测像素尺寸。
色彩：主红 #C9381E、米白 #F4F1E9、墨黑 #111111、赭金 #9B5E00；次正文 #62625D、分隔线 #D6D4CB。暖色约 40%、中性色约 60% 为整体方向，阅读区优先清楚易读。
字体与网格：英文与数字 Instrument Sans 400/500/600；中文说明 Noto Sans SC。桌面主标题 48—88px、手机 36—48px；正文 16—18px。桌面 12 列、最大内容宽 1320px、边距通常 64px；手机 4 列、约 20—24px 边距。
Logo：批准 A2 PNG 直接使用，不能重画、描摹或改为普通文字。浅底暖色版本，红底和深底纯白版本；横版字标建议至少 180 CSS px，安全区为导出画布高度的 20%。24° 切面是独立辅助图形，不拆用 Logo 笔画。
组件与动效：按钮和主要面板直角，小部件最多 4px 圆角；分隔线 1px；间距采用 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96。动效以 160/240ms、淡入和最多 8px 上移为限。减少动态偏好时禁用变换、入场与顺滑滚动。
实现边界：选定方向后，在 apps/outrise-homepage 独立使用 React + Vite + TypeScript 实现完整英文单页，不改内部 product-console。本次 content.en.json 集中维护正文、导航与稳定锚点。

ul.li: 320、390、768、1440px 下没有横向溢出、媒体变形、标题遮挡或按钮丢失；手机重新组织布局，不整体缩小桌面。
导航、页内锚点、手机菜单、FAQ、真实邮箱和回到顶部可用；支持键盘、明确焦点、菜单焦点回归及展开状态。
图片有准确 alt；装饰元素不承担唯一信息；支持 prefers-reduced-motion，无强制自动轮播、视差劫持或连续漂浮。
三组布局确有区别，两类客户与两项核心能力等权，三执行和伙伴协作层级明确；匿名素材完整、来源可追溯。
构建检查通过，无页面报错或失效资源；相关变更检查后提交指定仓库并验证推送。
